locale.description: The language code of this translation, used to format names and times. Do not translate; use the code of the language of this file.

extDescription.message: Switch between Autodarts accounts on a shared display with one tap, without signing in again.
extDescription.description: The description of the extension, at most 132 characters.

badgeTitle.message: Player Switch for Autodarts – sign in again: $NAMES$
badgeTitle.description: The tooltip of the toolbar icon while accounts have to sign in again. $NAMES$ is a list of their names, such as 'Ada and Bob'.

badgeUnsaved.message: Player Switch for Autodarts – an account on Autodarts isn't saved yet
badgeUnsaved.description: The tooltip of the toolbar icon while a '+' on it says that someone is signed in on Autodarts who isn't saved yet.

badgeSaved.message: Player Switch for Autodarts – $NAME$ is saved
badgeSaved.description: The tooltip of the toolbar icon for a moment after a new account was saved by itself, while the icon shows a check mark.

renewed.description: When the extension last renewed the parked session of an account. $WHEN$ is a relative time, such as '3 hours ago'.

renewalFailing.message: Renewal failing since $WHEN$; it keeps trying.
renewalFailing.description: Since when the extension can't renew the parked session of an account because Autodarts doesn't answer; it tries again every 15 minutes. $WHEN$ is a date and a time, such as 'Oct 22, 2026, 9:15 PM'.

updateHintText.message: Autodarts may have changed how it signs in. Check for an update of Player Switch.

addingText.message: Sign in on Autodarts with the new player. The account is saved by itself.

savedAccount.message: $NAME$ is saved. A tap on a tile switches players.

unsavedText.message: Someone is signed in on Autodarts who isn't saved here yet.

removeConfirm.message: Remove $NAME$ from this display? Their session at Autodarts ends as well. Sign in again to add the account back.

removed.message: $NAME$ is removed and signed out at Autodarts.

removedOffline.message: $NAME$ is removed from this display. Autodarts can't be reached, so the session there ends only when it expires.

forgetAllConfirm.message: Every account is signed out at Autodarts and removed from this display, with its remembered password. The PINs and the settings start over as after the install.

forgotAll.message: All accounts are forgotten and signed out at Autodarts.

forgotAllOffline.message: All accounts are forgotten on this display. Autodarts can't be reached, so their sessions there end only when they expire.

passwordHint.message: Only used when the saved sign-in stops working. It stays on this computer and goes only to Autodarts.

switchSignIn.message: $NAME$ has to sign in again: use Add account to sign in once on Autodarts, or remember the password.

unreachable.message: Autodarts can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

noPage.message: Autodarts didn't answer in a tab. Open Autodarts, then try again.

unknownFormat.message: Your saved accounts come from a newer version of Player Switch. Update the extension to use them; this version leaves them untouched.
unknownFormat.description: Shown when the stored accounts are in a format that this version of the extension doesn't know, such as after going back to an older version.

empty.message: No accounts yet. Choose Add account and sign in on Autodarts: each account is saved by itself.

error.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

keysHint.message: Keys 1 to 9 pick a player, Esc closes.

reloadAfterUpdate.message: Player Switch was updated. Reload the page to use it? A running match ends on this display.

matchText.message: Switching ends it on this display.

matchSignOutText.message: Signing the player out ends it on this display.

commandToggle.message: Open or close the switcher in the Autodarts page

optionsButton.message: The button in the Autodarts page

optionShowButton.message: Show the button on the Autodarts page

optionShowButtonHint.message: A tap on it shows the players over the page, also in fullscreen and kiosk mode, where the toolbar is out of reach. The keyboard shortcut opens them as well.

helpUrl.description: The address of the help page of the website, docs/help.md, which explains every message of the extension. Do not translate; use the address of its page in the language of this file, or the English one, and quote each message in that page.

report.description: The link to the bug form, which it fills in with the versions of the extension and the browser.

welcomeLead.message: Set up the shared display in three steps. Afterwards, a tap on a tile switches players.

welcomePinText.message: Chrome puts new extensions behind the puzzle piece next to the address bar. Click it, then the pin next to Player Switch for Autodarts, and the icon stays in the toolbar.

pinPictureText.message: The toolbar of Chrome: the puzzle piece next to the address bar opens the list of extensions, and the pin next to Player Switch for Autodarts keeps its icon in the toolbar.
pinPictureText.description: The text alternative of the picture that shows how to pin the icon.

pinPictureMenu.description: The heading of the list of extensions in Chrome, as Chrome names it in this language.

welcomeFirstText.message: Open Autodarts and sign in. In the next ten minutes, the account is saved by itself, and the icon shows a check mark. Someone who is signed in already is saved the same way.

welcomeNextText.message: Click the icon, choose Add account and sign in as the next player: that account is saved by itself too.

welcomePlusText.message: A + on the icon means that someone is signed in who isn't saved yet: Save account in the popup saves them.

welcomePrivacy.message: Everything stays on this computer and goes only to Autodarts.

pinLabel.description: The label of the field for a PIN, and the mark on the tile of an account that asks for one.

pinPad.description: The name, for screen readers, of the number pad in the question for a PIN.

pinDelete.description: The name, for screen readers, of the key of the number pad that takes the last digit back.

pinOk.description: The button that confirms a PIN.

pinTitle.description: The title of the question for the PIN of an account, before a switch to it. $NAME$ is the name of the player.

pinText.message: This account asks for its PIN before anyone plays under it.

pinLocked.message: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in a minute.

managerPinTitle.description: The title of the question for the manager PIN, and the heading of its part of the options page.

managerPinText.message: Enter the manager PIN to manage the accounts and the settings.

optionsLocked.message: A manager PIN guards these settings. Enter it to change them.

optionsVenue.description: The heading of the venue mode on the options page.

optionsVenueHint.message: Everything here is off until you turn it on. A PIN keeps the people at the display from playing under someone else's account; it doesn't protect against someone who can use this computer.

managerPinOff.message: No manager PIN is set: anyone at the display can manage the accounts and change these settings.

managerPinOn.message: The manager PIN guards Manage accounts and these settings.

removeManagerPinConfirm.message: Anyone at the display can then manage the accounts and change these settings.
removeManagerPinConfirm.description: The question before the manager PIN is removed.

playerPinsHint.message: An account with a PIN asks for it before anyone switches to it, in the popup and on the Autodarts page.

pinSet.description: Shown beside an account on the options page that has a PIN.

noPin.description: Shown beside an account on the options page that has no PIN.

newPinFor.description: The title of the question for a new PIN of an account. $NAME$ is the name of the player.

newPinText.message: Choose 4 to 8 digits that you can remember.

repeatPinText.message: Enter the same digits once more.

pinMismatch.message: The two PINs differ. Choose the PIN again.

idleNever.description: The choice that turns the return after a break off.

idleMinutes.description: A length of a break. $COUNT$ is a number of minutes, from 5 to 60.

idleSignOut.description: The choice that signs the Autodarts page out after a break, instead of a switch to a house account.

idleHint.message: A break is the time without a tap, click or key on the Autodarts page. A match is never interrupted: the break starts once it has ended. The player before keeps their session parked, so a tap brings them back.
